question: Under RKSK, Adolescent Friendly Health Clinics (AFHCs) are established at the Sub-Centre level to maximise reach to rural adolescents.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is FALSE. AFHCs are sited at PHC/CHC/SDH level, not Sub-Centres. Sub-Centres lack the trained counsellor and medical officer resources that RKSK requires for a functioning AFHC session. The referral ladder goes: AFHC (CHC) → PHC MO → district hospital specialist.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — the statement is false. AFHCs under RKSK are established at the Sub-District Hospital (SDH) / Community Health Centre (CHC) level and above — not at Sub-Centres. Sub-Centres do not have the clinical personnel (trained counsellors, MOs) required to deliver AFHS. Dedicated weekly or bi-weekly AFHC sessions are held at PHC/CHC level.
